extractor_notes.blockers: VivoSim Labs (formerly Organovo) is a preclinical 3D liver-tissue-based discovery platform. The available 8-K filings cover corporate name change and capital structure events; none disclose specific clinical-stage IND/NDA/topline catalysts with anticipated dates. The 2026-04-03 Ex-99.1 (containing latest update) was inaccessible via SEC EDGAR due to repeated 429 rate-limiting on the specific URL.
